title: What is Prompt Engineering?
description: Discover the fundamentals of AI language models and how prompt engineering turns you into a director of AI.

slides.title: Welcome to the AI Era 🌍
slides.content:
# The Rise of Large Language Models

You’ve probably heard of **ChatGPT**, **Gemini**, or **Claude**. These are **Large Language Models (LLMs)** – AI systems trained on vast amounts of text to predict and generate human-like language.

- They can write emails, code, poetry, and even help with homework.
- They don’t “think” like humans; they generate responses based on patterns they learned.
- Your input – the **prompt** – is the steering wheel.

slides.title: The Genie in the Lamp 🧞
slides.content:
## Imagine an all‑powerful genie

But there’s a catch: the genie takes every word literally. If you say “I wish for a fast car,” you might get a toy car – it’s fast *and* a car!

A **prompt** is exactly your wish. **Prompt Engineering** is the art of phrasing that wish so the genie (LLM) gives you exactly what you want, nothing less, nothing else.

> “The quality of your output is directly proportional to the quality of your input.”

quizData.question: What is a Large Language Model (LLM)?

options.text: A search engine that finds web pages.
An AI trained on massive text data to generate language.
A hardware chip for voice assistants.

quizData.explanation: LLMs are AI systems (like GPT-4) that learn patterns from huge text corpora and produce human-like text.

slides.title: From Instructions to Prompts 📜
slides.content:
## Traditional programming vs. Prompting

- In programming, you write **exact syntax** – a missing semicolon breaks everything.
- With LLMs, you write **natural language**. But vagueness leads to unpredictable results.

**Prompt Engineering** bridges the gap: you learn to structure natural language with precision, so the AI behaves predictably.

It’s like learning to give clear directions to a very literal friend.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## The Golden Rule

> **Assume the model knows nothing except what you tell it.**

Every piece of context you provide reduces the chance of hallucination (made‑up facts). Start your prompt engineering mindset with this rule.

quizData.question: In the genie analogy, why is a vague prompt a problem?

options.text: The genie interprets words literally, so vague words cause unexpected results.
The genie only grants three wishes.

quizData.explanation: LLMs, like the literal genie, don't infer hidden intent – they work with the exact words you supply. Precision avoids wild misinterpretations.

slides.title: What You’ll Master 🎓
slides.content:
## By the end of this course, you will:

- Craft crystal‑clear instructions that get exactly the output you want.
- Use examples and roles to steer tone, style, and accuracy.
- Debug and refine prompts like a pro.
- Build complex, multi‑step AI workflows.

Prompt engineering is not just typing questions – it’s a **design skill** that’s changing how we work with technology.
